payload.root_cause: In `truncate` (src/text.js:18-22), the truncation branch at line 21 does `return text.slice(0, max) + ellipsis;`. It slices the text to the full `max` characters and then appends the ellipsis, so the returned string has length `max + ellipsis.length` (8 + 3 = 11 for the reported case), violating the documented contract (docstring at line 16 and README) that the total length must never exceed `max` with the ellipsis included. The slice bound must reserve room for the ellipsis (i.e. slice to `max - ellipsis.length` before appending). The other two branches are correct: short text is returned unchanged (line 19) and `max <= ellipsis.length` correctly returns `ellipsis.slice(0, max)` (line 20), so the defect is isolated to line 21.
